# AI 获客 (AI Customer Acquisition)
> Open-source, continuously updated. Customer acquisition in the age of AI search and agents: GEO / answer engines, buyer agents and platform dependency. 一本免费公开、持续更新的开源书：用 AI 拓客——找到、选中、谈成、带走。

Key thesis: 客户不再只在搜索框和展会上挑供应商——他们问 AI、让 Agent 去筛、看平台推的和别人说的。
Source discipline: 每条数据句末标性质（五档主干+括注）；核不到原始发布方的数字不写入正文；自建实测公开方法与原始数据。

## Links
- Read online (Chinese): https://ai-customer-acquisition.fly2ai.top
- English edition（逐章英文文件在 book-en/）: https://github.com/Jweokk/ai-customer-acquisition-book/blob/main/book-en/00-preface-how-buyers-find-vendors.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/Jweokk/ai-customer-acquisition-book
- PDF (latest): https://github.com/Jweokk/ai-customer-acquisition-book/raw/main/book/ai-customer-acquisition.pdf
